Thermocline Specialist Suite
role: specialized subsurface temperature and thermocline diagnostics
nature_text: Thermocline-focused specialist system for subsurface ocean temperature. Consumes a seven-day history across seven input variables and predicts a fifteen-depth temperature profile together with thermocline depth D_TC and maximum vertical temperature-gradient magnitude G_max. Designed as a research specialist around the frozen OceanEmbed production prediction.
evidence_text: history seven days; seven variables; depths 0 5 10 20 30 50 75 100 125 150 200 300 500 700 1000 meters; temperature output; D_TC output; G_max output; thermocline pair mask and vertical-gradient evaluation; validation split 2023; test split 2024-2025.

name: U-Net Thermocline
nature_text: Spatial U-Net baseline for thermocline-focused temperature reconstruction. Uses the seven-day input history flattened across time and variables into convolutional channels. Produces the full fifteen-depth temperature profile and thermocline diagnostic outputs.
evidence_text: history seven days; input variables SST SSS SSH CURRENT_U CURRENT_V WIND_U WIND_V; best checkpoint best_thermocline.pt; final test global MAE 0.0799723 C; thermocline MAE 0.1218915 C; depth MAE 19.2209 m; gradient MAE 0.0354303 C/m.

name: U-Net ConvGRU Thermocline
nature_text: Spatiotemporal U-Net specialist using a ConvGRU temporal pathway to model evolution across the seven-day input sequence. Produces a fifteen-depth temperature profile and thermocline depth and gradient-strength diagnostics.
evidence_text: history seven days; seven ocean surface variables; temporal kind convgru; best checkpoint best_thermocline.pt; final test global MAE 0.0717639 C; thermocline MAE 0.1068294 C; depth MAE 16.7680 m; gradient MAE 0.0133431 C/m; 2023 soft-blend validation showed useful low-amplitude correction behavior.

name: U-Net ConvLSTM Thermocline
nature_text: Spatiotemporal U-Net specialist using ConvLSTM temporal memory over the seven-day sequence. Targets subsurface temperature structure around the thermocline while also producing thermocline depth and gradient-strength diagnostics.
evidence_text: history seven days; seven ocean surface variables; temporal kind convlstm; best checkpoint best_thermocline.pt; final test global MAE 0.0760048 C; thermocline MAE 0.1131410 C; depth MAE 16.6112 m; gradient MAE 0.0129871 C/m.

name: U-Net Transformer Thermocline
architecture: Temporal U-Net with Transformer temporal block
